question: If K X (sin A - 2sin³ A)/(2cos³ A - cos A) = 1, then the value of K is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

K × [sin A(1 − 2sin² A)] / [cos A(2cos² A − 1)] = 1

Since 1 − 2sin² A and 2cos² A − 1 both equal cos 2A, they cancel out.

K × (sin A / cos A) = 1 ⇒ K × tan A = 1

K = 1 / tan A = cotA

**∴ The correct answer is cotA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

K × [(sin A − 2sin³ A) / (2cos³ A − cos A)] = 1

**Formula Used:**

cos 2A = 1 − 2sin² A

cos 2A = 2cos² A − 1

tan A = sin A / cos A

**Calculations:**

⇒ K × [(sin A − 2sin³ A) / (2cos³ A − cos A)] = 1

⇒ K × [sin A(1 − 2sin² A)] / [cos A(2cos² A − 1)] = 1

⇒ K × (sin A × cos 2A) / (cos A × cos 2A) = 1

⇒ K × (sin A / cos A) = 1

⇒ K × tan A = 1

⇒ K = 1 / tan A

⇒ K = cotA

**∴ The correct answer is cotA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Double Angle Formulas

cos 2A = cos² A − sin² A = 2cos² A − 1 = 1 − 2sin² A

sin 2A = 2sin A × cos A

Pythagorean Identities

sin² A + cos² A = 1

1 + tan² A = sec² A

1 + cot² A = cosec² A
